passage: Last winter, Mia and her brother stayed at a small mountain resort for a school holiday. Before they left home, their dad asked Mia to select the warmest clothes and put them in the luggage. She packed a thick sock, a soft cushion for the bus, and her snowboard. On the first morning, the pavement outside the hotel was white with snow, so everyone walked slowly. Mia felt healthy and excited, and she was exactly on time for her lesson. After class, a photographer took pictures of the group. Mia wanted to keep the photo forever because it was her best winter trip.
